headline: Attackers weaponized Atlassian's Rovo AI to siphon enterprise data as maximum-severity zero-days in Metabase, N-able, and Progress LoadMaster fell to active exploitation.

emerging_trends.text: Attackers keep turning enterprise AI assistants against their owners, coaxing Atlassian's Rovo into exfiltrating Confluence and Jira data, while a study of more than 6,000 fixes finds AI-generated patches fail roughly half the time.
emerging_trends.topic_title: RovoBlast Turns Atlassian's Rovo AI Against Enterprise Data

emerging_trends.text: A cluster of maximum-severity flaws in Metabase, N-able N-central, and Progress Kemp LoadMaster sits under live exploitation, with intruders reaching managed systems and persisting faster than defenders can patch.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Metabase, N-able, and LoadMaster Fall to Active Exploitation

emerging_trends.text: Fresh intrusions reached a healthcare software vendor, a military parts maker, and the Swiss federal IT office, showing no sector sits outside data-theft crews' range.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Breaches Strike Healthcare, Military, and Swiss Government

topics.title: Metabase, N-able, and LoadMaster Fall to Active Exploitation
topics.latest_developments: Metabase confirmed its unauthenticated SQL injection flaw carries a maximum CVSS 10.0 and grants admin access as a zero-day, N-able shipped N-central Hotfix 2 after attackers reached managed systems and persisted, and Progress Kemp LoadMaster CVE-2026-8037 entered CISA's catalog following 792 reported exploit attempts.
topics.summary: Three widely deployed enterprise tools face live attacks: Metabase business intelligence, already breaching Framework and Tally; N-able N-central remote monitoring; and Progress Kemp LoadMaster load balancers, hit by a CVSS 9.6 command injection. Patch all three immediately.

sources.title: Metabase Zero-Day Exploited in Wild Allows Admin Access Without Authentication
N-able Issues N-central Hotfix 2 as Attackers Reach Managed Systems and Persist
Progress Kemp LoadMaster Flaw Hits CISA KEV After 792 Reported Exploit Attempts
Metabase SQLi zero-day exploited in customer data-theft attacks

topics.title: RovoBlast Turns Atlassian's Rovo AI Against Enterprise Data
topics.latest_developments: Varonis disclosed RovoBlast, a one-click method that abused Atlassian's Rovo assistant to steal Confluence, Jira, and SharePoint data, while PromptArmor independently reached the same theft by hiding instructions in a file Rovo read.
topics.summary: Atlassian's Rovo AI assistant reads Confluence, Jira, and SharePoint on a signed-in user's behalf. Attackers plant hidden instructions in content Rovo ingests, then exfiltrate any data the user can reach; Atlassian confirms only one of the two attack routes closed. Restrict Rovo's data access and untrusted inputs.

sources.title: Critical One-Click Vulnerability in Atlassian’s Rovo AI Exposed Enterprise Data
Atlassian Rovo Can Be Tricked Into Sending Jira and Confluence Data to Attackers

topics.title: CSS Attacks Break Major Webmail Defenses
topics.latest_developments: PortSwigger researcher Gareth Heyes revealed new CSS attacks that let email content escape its message boundary across Outlook, Gmail, Fastmail, Proton Mail, Yahoo Mail, and AOL Mail to steal passwords and tokens.
topics.summary: The techniques manipulate the webmail interface from inside a rendered message to capture passwords, hijack third-party accounts, leak tokens, seize trusted UI actions, and manipulate AI tools that read email. Webmail providers must sanitize CSS in message rendering.

sources.title: New CSS Attacks Can Break Webmail Defenses to Steal Passwords and Tokens

topics.title: Breaches Strike Healthcare, Military, and Swiss Government
topics.latest_developments: Unlimited Technology Systems said an October 2025 breach hit 3.8 million people, IEH Corporation, which builds parts for military satellites, missiles, and fighter jets, disclosed a phishing-driven mailbox breach to the SEC, and Switzerland's Federal Office of Information Technology, Systems and Telecommunication reported hackers exploited its SharePoint servers to compromise about 200 accounts.
topics.summary: Three unrelated intrusions surfaced across healthcare software, defense manufacturing, and government IT. Affected organizations should force credential resets and review third-party and SharePoint exposure.

sources.title: Unlimited Technology Systems breach impacts 3.8 million people
Military device manufacturer discloses cyber incident to SEC
200 accounts compromised in Swiss government’s Microsoft SharePoint breach

topics.title: AI-Generated Patches Fail Half the Time
topics.latest_developments: A study of more than 6,000 patches found AI-generated fixes fail roughly half the time, and even successful ones introduce new bugs, break other functionality, or remain open to bypass.
topics.summary: The research undercuts hopes that large language models can autonomously close vulnerabilities and warns teams to keep human review on any machine-written patch before merging.

sources.title: AI-Generated Patches Fail Half the Time

topics.summary: The ruling creates a fund to mitigate social media harms to minors and marks a large state-level penalty over child safety, signaling rising legal exposure for platforms over youth mental health.
